en-US.description:
What holiday is it today?
                                                                              
  There is always something to celebrate. CelebriDay delivers a fresh holiday
  to your phone every single morning, complete with fun facts and everything  
  you need to share the joy with friends and family.        
                                                                              
  From National Pizza Day to World Emoji Day to the wonderfully quirky ones   
  you never knew existed, there is a celebration waiting for you every day of
  the year.                                                                   
                                                            
  DAILY HOLIDAY NOTIFICATIONS                                                 
  Wake up to a delightful notification every morning telling you exactly what
  holiday it is today. Each alert includes a fun fact to brighten your day    
  before you even get out of bed.                           
                                                                              
  BEAUTIFUL HOLIDAY CARDS                                                     
  Today's holidays appear as vibrant, color coded cards right on your home
  screen. Every card includes the full holiday name, a description, a fun     
  fact, and a Share button so you can spread the celebration instantly.
                                                                              
  FULL YEAR CALENDAR                                                          
  Browse all 365 days at a glance. Every single day has its own celebration,
  organized by category with color coded dots so you can spot your favorites  
  from across the month. Tap any day to explore its holidays in a beautiful
  pull up sheet.                                                              
                                                            
  365 DAYS OF FUN FACTS                                                       
  Over 365 unique holidays with a hand picked fun fact for every one. You will
   never run out of something interesting to bring up at dinner.              
                                                            
  CELEBRIDAY PREMIUM                                                          
  Take your celebrations to the next level.                 

  No ads. Ever. Open the app and go straight to your holidays with zero       
  interruptions.
                                                                              
  Save your favorites. Tap the heart on any holiday card to keep a collection 
  of the ones you love most.
                                                                              
  Custom notification time. Choose exactly when your daily alert arrives,     
  whether that is 6 AM with your coffee or 10 AM at your desk.
                                                                              
  Home screen widgets. Coming soon. Today's holiday right where you see it    
  first.                                          
                                                                           
  CelebriDay is free to download. Premium features are available as a monthly 
  or annual subscription. Subscriptions renew automatically and can be        
  cancelled anytime through your App Store account settings.   

---------------------------------------------------------------

Privacy Policy: https://ramseysmith.github.io/CelebriDay/privacy-policy.html

Faster, cleaner startup every time you open the app
Small polish and stability improvements across the calendar and favorites
Thanks for celebrating with us every day. If CelebriDay puts a smile on your morning, a quick rating really helps us grow.
en-US.promoText: Every day is a holiday you never knew about. Wake up to a fun new celebration each morning, save your favorites, and never miss a reason to smile.
